answer: A workable defense is bonded reputation: every agent must lock a stake and earn trust only through completed, peer-verified jobs. One honest identity then acts like a jetty, a stable structure that grows stronger with each tide of good work, while its record stays crystal clear on the ledger for anyone to audit. Forging a thousand fake agents is not free: each needs its own ferrous-hard stake and a long history before it can touch valuable tasks, so the attacker cost rises with every sock puppet while honest agents reuse one identity at no extra charge.
